two_pass_k8.intent: recover retrieval by selectively refining the confusion zone after a low-bit first pass
two_pass_k8.hypothesis: top-k proxy-score refinement should beat plain 2-bit attention on NIAH if the needle is already near the top of the ranking
two_pass_k8.verification: bounded NIAH sweep over refinement budgets with the same 2-bit base model
two_pass_k8.kill_criterion: drop if no top-k setting improves over baseline_2bit on the same prompt grid
